page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 8 vCPUs across 4 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, accompanied by 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1 data cache. Memory is constrained to 8.0 GB total, yielding a tight 1:1 allocation ratio of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include support for AVX-512 extensions such as AVX-512F and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside AES cryptographic acceleration.

Storage and networking specifications reflect a pure compute model. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for system operating systems and persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is configured at 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. Accelerators such as GPUs are not present on this machine type.

Empirical benchmarks indicate performance characteristics primarily in the lower quartiles. The instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 996.0 and a multi-core score of 3814.0, while Stress-NG scores registered at 1106.2 for single-core and 5887.4 for multi-core. PassMark tests place general CPU performance in the average tier at 7018.44 points, though memory operations scored in the bottom 25% at 1521.5. Large-block memory bandwidth demonstrated average uncached throughput (39.9 GB/sec read, 32.58 GB/sec write), but single-threaded compression tests like gzip placed in the bottom 10% (19.29 GB/sec).

Given its 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM balance and lower-tier throughput in database and memory benchmarks, the ecs.ic5.2xlarge is best positioned for compute tasks that do not require high memory footprints. Workloads that match this profile include batch processing, lightweight Clang software builds, distributed worker tasks, and computational microservices where CPU core density takes precedence over large working sets.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor under the KVM hypervisor. Configured with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores, it features an x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 instruction support, complemented by an 8.0 GB RAM footprint that delivers 1.0 GB of memory per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware accelerators, depending entirely on network storage and a 2 Gbps baseline network link. Benchmark evaluations position its raw processing capability primarily in the bottom 25% to middle 50%, with PassMark CPU scoring 7018.44 and Geekbench multi-core reaching 3814.0. Due to its restrictive memory-to-core allocation, ecs.ic5.2xlarge is engineered for low-memory CPU batch processing, background tasks, code compilation, and distributed worker nodes.
